## File: facebookresearch_rlmeta/examples/atari/dqn/atari_dqn_model.py

Prompts

```
['create an AtariDQNNet with a Nature or Impala CNN backbone and Dueling or standard DQN head', 'build an AtariDQNModel with configurable network type, dueling DQN, spectral norm, and double DQN options', 'test the AtariDQNModel act method to sample epsilon-greedy actions from observation tensors', 'review the AtariDQNModel q method to gather Q-values for specific state-action pairs', 'refactor the AtariDQNModel sync_target_net method to update target network weights from the online network']
```
